title: Conclusion & references
summary: Closing thoughts, key take-aways from the course, and the sources and licence.

blocks.text: This free course provided an introduction to studying Management. It took you through a series of exercises designed to develop your approach to study and learning at a distance and helped to improve your confidence as an independent learner.

items: A project is a unique venture with a beginning and an end; it moves from an existing to a desired state.
Decisions should be objective and quantitative: weighted criteria, decision trees and EMV, checklists, while remembering their dependence on estimates.
Projects follow a basic or extended life cycle; the milestones and deliverables matter more than the model.
Success is judged by criteria (what) and critical success factors (how).
The project manager plans, builds the team, manages stakeholders, coordinates work and controls change.
Software is intangible, complex and malleable; phased, prototype and agile approaches help manage that.
